paite: Huan tuipiau ah thu ahilh nawn hi. Mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in tuipi ah long ah tuang in atu a, mipi tengteng tuipiau a leitung ah a-om uhi.
heading: Buhchithehpa Gentehna / (Mat 13.1-9; Luk 8.4-8)

paite: Huan gentehna zang in thil tampi asinsak a, amah sinsakna dan in akiang uah,
"Ngaikhia unla, en dih ua; buhchithehpa buhchi theh ding in akuan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, atheh lai in akhen lampi sik ah akia a, vasate'n anegai uhi.
Akhen suangsilei ah akia a; lei asah louh ziak in apou pah hi.
Himahleh ni ahong suah in haivuai in ahong om a, zung aneih louh ziak in avuaimang uhi.
Akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa ahong khang a, buhkungte adepmang a, agahta kei hi.
Akhen lei hoih a kia in apou a, akhanglian a, agah a; aleh sawmthum aleh sawmguk leh aleh za in apung chiat uhi,” achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Huan amah kia a-om lai in akim a omte leh sawm-le-nihte'n gentehna thu adongchian thak uhi.
heading: Gentehna Thiltup / (Mat 13.10-17; Luk 8.9-10)

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam thuguk zaw noute kiang a piak ahi a, polam mite a ding in bel bangkim gentehna a gen ahi.
Muh zaw amu na ua, atheisiam kei ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akihei nawn ding ua, ngaihdam ahong hi kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai gentehna thu na theisiam kei uh maw? Huchi ahih in bangchi in gentehna tengteng na theisiam tuan ding ua?
heading: Buhchithehpa Gentehna Hilhchetna / (Mat 13.18-23; Luk 8.11-15)

paite: Buhchithehpa'n thu atheh ahi.
Lamsik a thu theh hiai bang ahi uh; thu azaktak un kintak a Setan hong pai in alungtang ua thu theh alakmangsak hi.
Huchibang mah in suangsilei a theh hiaite ahi uh; thu azak phet ua kipaktak a pom pahte.
Himahleh amau ah zung anei kei ua, sawt louchik kia a-om uh; huai nung in thu ziak a gimthuakna hiam sawina hiam ahong om phet in akipuk pah uhi.
Huan midangte loulingnei lak a theh bang ahi uh; huaite'n thu azata ua,
himahleh khovel lunggulhnate, thil dang duhgawlnate ahong lut chiang in, thu adep a, gah lou in a-om hi.
Huchi in lei hoih a kia hiaite ahi uh; thu za a, pom, aleh sawmthum, aleh sawmguk leh aleh za a gahte ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Mi'n khawnvak de in akoihna a koih lou in, loh nuai hiam, lupna nuai hiam ah akoih ngei ua hia?
heading: Khawnvak A Pan Gentehna / (Luk 8.16-18)

paite: Thang lou ding a iim bangmah a-om ngei kei a, lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na zak uh bang ahia, pilvang un; na tehna ngei mah ua tehsak in na om ding ua, atamzaw bawn piak in na om ding uhi.
Kuapeuh anei piak behlap in a-om ding ua, kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak in om ding," achi hi.
"Pathian lalgam tuh mi'n lei a chi atuh bang ahi," achi hi.
heading: Haichitang A Pan Sinsakna

paite: "Zan chiang in a-ihmu a, sun chiang in athou zel a; chi pou in ana khang a, himahleh bangchi a pou a, khang ahia chih athei kei.
Lei in amah in gah ahon suah a; amasapen in akung, huan avui leh avui ah atang hong om hi.
Himahleh agah amin chiang in, kawite in a-at pah uhi; buhlak ahun tak ziak in," achi hi.
Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh i tehpih dia? Ahihkeileh, bang gentehna in ahia i genteh ding? achi hi.
heading: Ankam Tang Gentehna / (Mat 13.31-32; Luk 13.18-19)

paite: Ankam chi tang khat lei a atuh un, lei a chi tengteng sang in neupen mahleh,
atuh nung un ahong pou a, loupa tengteng sang in ahong lianzawta a, hiang liantak ahon nei a, huchi in tungleng vasate alim ah agiak uh, huchi mah bang ahi," achi hi.
Huan huchibang gentehna thu tampi in, atheihsiam theih khomkhom uh, akiang uah agen zel hi.
Himahleh gentehna lou in zaw akiang uah thu agen ngei kei; amah nungzuite kiang ah asim in bangkim ahilhchian zel hi.
Huai ni mah nitaklam ahong hih in, akiang uah, "Gal khat lam i kai ding uh," achi hi.
heading: Huihpi Jesu'n Adaisak / (Mat 8.23-27; Luk 8.22-25)

paite: Huchi in mipite paisan in, a-om ngeingei bang in, long ah apaipih pah ua, long dangte leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in huihpi thupitak ahong nung a, tuikihotte long ah ahong kihotlut zuazua hi, huchi in long ahong dimta hi.
Amah lukham kham a ihmu in, longmei lam ah a-om hi. Huan aphawng ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, ka manthat uh khawk sa lou na hi maw?" achi uhi.
Amah ahong thou a, huih atai a, tuipi kiang ah leng, "Dai inla om kinken in," achi hi. Huan huih atawp a, hong dai dide hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchi a hichi tel a lau na hi ua oi? Ginna nei lou na hi uh maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in lau petmah in alau ua, "Hiai mi kua ahia le, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" akichi uhi.
